known_results: V62 mean screen improves all three studies; partial count panels show HCT small-panel PDS loss, HEK/CD4 case fidelity losses. This is a disclosed outcome-informed follow-up, not blind hypothesis discovery.
hypothesis: Interpolate in normalized bulk proportions towards the fixed V62 assay estimate, accepting the largest dyadic fraction whose realized float32 profile retains at least 80% of every V24 target-versus-target cosine-template margin. This protects prior identity, not truth; no query treatment labels or reference profiles enter. All 300 panel genes excluded from anchor geometry. Exact own-target factor is used only in compositional closure and later applied once by the emitter.
selection: One fixed primary; no strength grid selected on outcomes. Evaluate all 20 development cases against V24 and the equally guarded source-target shuffled diagnostic; confirmation remaining24 cases, two seeds, only after development support. Raw expression must improve, PDS loss<=.005, FID loss<=.002, REACH loss<=.005, JAC loss<=.0005, NMAE no worse>1%, >=3 metrics improve and positive oriented relative average; beats shuffled on expression and PDS. Report any failure. Explicit experimental build is permitted solely for the user-requested diagnostic artifact and must not be labeled validated improvement.
